title.zh: 机器人AI公司Physical Intelligence估值冲向200亿美元，至今还没有收入
title.en: 机器人AI公司Physical Intelligence估值冲向200亿美元，至今还没有收入

current_state.zh: Robotics-AI startup Physical Intelligence is reportedly negotiating a raise of at least $1 billion at about a $20 billion valuation, despite having no revenue, as investor appetite for general-purpose robot 'brain' software intensifies alongside competitor Skild AI's paid-customer traction.
